query:
SELECT 
  p.id,
  p.name,
  p.isComposite,
  p.currentStock,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM productCompositions WHERE parentProductId = p.id) as num_compositions
FROM products p
WHERE p.name LIKE '%Coca%' OR p.name LIKE '%6 Unidades%'
ORDER BY p.id DESC;
